metadata.description: A cracked elevated aqueduct carries stagnant greywater over a marshy lower canal. The visible top voxel of the five-block terrain base now uses Minecraft-style grass-over-dirt blocks, while canal and basin water remain intact. Below the grass cap is a logical floodplain sediment profile: greywater silt, alluvial clay, older river gravel, and compacted clay hardpan. The central span has collapsed into a plunge pool with broken stairs, a failed eastern ramp, mossy parapets, and fallen columns creating multiple tactical elevations.
